name: manual_5e6b45
claim: A per-run observer must resolve the identity of an uncertain attempt from the authoritative ledger at the moment a critical delivery fails, never from constructor strings: blank ids make UnknownDisposition reject the record and a swallowed ValueError silently loses it, and a disposition only exists if something actually persists it.

decisions.notes: Oramasys T2: BoundedObserver took attempt, hold and epoch at construction though a run has many attempts, its failure path returned on ValueError, and StepLedger.mark_unknown had no production caller, so no durable disposition could exist by any wiring. Fixed with bind_authority reading started-and-unsettled holds (the rule recover() already uses) and persisting through the validated mark_unknown, keeping unpersisted records instead of masking the sink failure.
